{{See also|Changes from vanilla}}
This page lists vanilla features that [[Matcha Flavoured]] removes or disables, and features the pack itself once had but later removed. Most vanilla recipes the pack replaces are blocked through the filter in the datapack's <code>pack.mcmeta</code>, which hides {{Data/Blocked vanilla/Recipes}} vanilla recipes and the {{Data/Blocked vanilla/Tabs}} vanilla advancement tabs; [[#Blocked vanilla recipes and advancements|the full list]] is at the end of this page.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

== Removed vanilla features ==
; Stone tools
: The vanilla stone tool recipes are blocked. Progression goes from wood straight to copper.<ref>{{Source|README.md}}</ref> See [[Progression]].
; Hunger
: The food bar is hidden and held in a fixed range: the pack applies Hunger when the food level is 10 or more and Saturation when it falls to 6 or lower, so the player can always sprint and food matters only for healing and effects.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/manage_hunger.mcfunction}}</ref> See [[Hunger]].
; Natural regeneration
: The <code>natural_health_regeneration</code> gamerule is set to false on first load. The player heals by eating.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/setup/gamerules.mcfunction}}</ref> See [[Natural regeneration]].
; Item loss on death
: Keep inventory is turned on when the world is first loaded and when new players join. Death costs maximum [[health]] instead. See [[Death]].
; Phantoms
: The <code>spawn_phantoms</code> gamerule is set to false.
; Rotten flesh
: Zombies drop [[Tattered Leather|tattered leather]] instead. The rotten flesh item ID is reused for [[Glow Berry Mash|glow berry mash]].<ref>{{Cite video|quote=Rotten flesh no longer exists.}}</ref>
; Enchanting table and random enchanting
: The enchanting table recipe is blocked; enchantments are crafted as [[blessing]]s. A broken enchanting table drops its parts. The recipe was blocked in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.10|1.10]]; the developer had thought it was already blocked.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.10|quote=Enchanting Table (I thought this was blocked, I feel it may have made a lot of people confused)}}</ref>
; Potions and brewing
: The vanilla brewing stand, fermented spider eye, glistering melon and magma cream recipes are blocked, and most potion effects come from [[food]] instead. See [[Brewing]].
; Vanilla advancements
: All five vanilla advancement tabs are blocked and replaced. See [[Advancements]].
; Crafting-grid repair
: The vanilla <code>repair_item</code> recipe is blocked; equipment is repaired in an [[anvil]], without the experience cap. See [[Repairing]].
; Other blocked vanilla recipes
: Besides the above, the filter blocks several hundred vanilla recipes, listed [[#Blocked vanilla recipes and advancements|below]]. Most are replaced by the pack's own recipes with different ingredients or at a different station: ores are smelted in the [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]] (copper also in the [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]]), and chiseled blocks come from the [[stonecutter]]. A few items have no recipe left at all.
; Sapling and stick drops from leaves
: Leaves drop neither; each sapling is crafted from one of its leaves, a recipe unlocked by picking up the matching log.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/oak_leaves.json}}</ref> Removed in [[Matcha Flavoured 0.5-alpha|0.5-alpha]].

== Blocked vanilla recipes and advancements ==
Every vanilla recipe and advancement tab that the datapack's filter hides, grouped by the station and recipe book tab vanilla gave the recipe. Items are listed by their name in Matcha Flavoured. "Still made with" lists the stations whose recipes still make the item: the pack's own recipes and the vanilla recipes it keeps. "None" means no recipe makes it any more; such items can still come from loot, trading or other sources.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
